name: 14-hydroxycodeine
summary: 14-Hydroxycodeine also known as hydroxycodeine, is an toxic opioid, and also an alkaloid an organic compound that is a minor natural product found in some plants and is an important intermediate in the synthesis of potent opioid analgesics such as oxycodone and other 14-hydroxylated opiate drugs. It is not used as a standalone drug and has no medical use.

uses.en: It is a chemical step in making stronger 14-hydroxylated opioids and has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是製造更強效14-羥基鴉片類藥物的化學中間體，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是制造更强效14-羟基鸦片类药物的化学中间体，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: Many 14-hydroxylated opioids, including oxycodone, are made from thebaine, a minor alkaloid of the opium poppy, rather than from morphine.
fact.zh: 許多14-羥基鴉片類藥物，包括羥考酮（oxycodone），都是以罌粟中的次要生物鹼蒂巴因（thebaine）為原料，而非嗎啡。
fact.zhHans: 许多14-羟基鸦片类药物，包括羟考酮（oxycodone），都是以罂粟中的次要生物碱蒂巴因（thebaine）为原料，而非吗啡。
